notes.title: Mercenarian Newest Features Trailer!!
notes.content:
In commemoration of [b]Indonesian Game Day[/b], [i]Lazy Monday[/i] celebrated by covering various games made in Indonesia in an event called [i]Hargai 2024[/i] and thankfully Mercenarian is one of them. 

The video is already live on their YouTube channel and you can see the newest Mercenarian features as a trailer there! You can also watch it from Mercenarian Steam page.
[url=https://youtu.be/-wNl_xk2-eI?t=686]Mercenarian Trailer on Lazy Monday [/url]

[h3]In the new trailer, you can see the following new things below:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new mechanic, the [b]Strong Attack[/b] that allow you to hit more enemies at once, have a chance to knock back the enemy, and of course more damage.
[*] More particle effects when hitting the enemy.
[*] The Background Music (BGM) used in the trailer will be the BGM of the Slimy Forest area in the game.
[*] Lastly, a spoiler for a new type of enemy, some kind of semi-boss enemy.
[/list]

I hope you guys love these new additions and don’t forget to check other Indonesian games out there :D.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/hargai2024]Indonesian Games on Steam[/url]

Don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/VqZJsyB545]Discord Community[/url], follow [url=https://twitter.com/GSpuun92889]Good Spuun Twitter[/url], and subscribe to[url=https://www.youtube.com/@GoodSpuun?sub_confirmation=1] Good Spuun YouTube[/url] for more updates in the future!

Spuun

notes.title: The End Of Playtest!
notes.content:
Hey Mercenary!

The playtest period is over now. Thank you for participating! I gain so much wonderful feedback to make the game even better! 

The current version of the game is already getting better, but more is needed. These small additions are just a part of many constructive inputs gathered from the playtest period. 

Here are some improvement to the game.

[h3][b]Polishing The Camera![/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=9QLeCjaqwUw;full][/previewyoutube]

To prevent foliages obstructing the player screen, now foliages will fade if in camera.

[h3][b]Health Bar Animation![/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=-9NuqX7zDQU;full][/previewyoutube]

Adding health bar animation when it's decreased. 

[h3][b]Pickup Notification![/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=sQ7fWqGuK9s;full][/previewyoutube]

Each time player loots something, there will be a notification for it and the amount as well.


[h2]What is the next step?[/h2]
After the playtest, I realize that there are many thing that can be improved in the current state of the game. I will focus on polishing and improving the current state of the game to make it better. When it's ready, the demo will be released for public.

[h3]If you want to get in touch:[/h3]
[b]Follow Good Spuun Twitter: [/b]https://twitter.com/GSpuun92889

[b]Join Discord Server:[/b] https://discord.gg/VqZJsyB545

[b]Subscribe to Youtube: [/b]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpN7W4NZnsN-Dl4UV4WVqIw?sub_confirmation=1


Devlog and updates will be shared there!

Even though the playtest is over, you still able to play the current state of the game (the link can be found in Discord Server). You can still also fill the feedback form. However, I don't plan on updating the game there. The next update will be the demo of the game on Steam! 

Don't forget to wishlist the game if you love it!
